summary: Each controller web replica on OpenShift uses database connections for WSGI workers and background services, while on VM and container installs WSGI connections scale with CPU count, and control nodes also run the dispatcher and callback receiver pools; adding control nodes therefore needs more database connections than scaling only the OpenShift web deployment.
questions: How many database connections does automation controller use?
Why does adding control nodes increase database connections?
Does scaling web replicas use database connections?
